columns.name: flight_number_had_the_longest_delay_in_departure
columns.description: the flight number of the flight operated by the airline that had the longest delay in departure, with ties broken by the ascending order of the flight number

columns.name: num_flights_operate_in_2018
columns.description: the number of flights operated by the airline in 2018, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: num_planes
columns.description: the number of planes operated by the airline, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: number_of_non_cancelled_flights
columns.description: the number of non-cancelled flights operated by the airline, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: total_hours_delayed_due_to_a_late_aircraft_in_2018
columns.description: the total hours delayed of the airline due to a late aircraft in 2018, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: num_flights_departure
columns.description: the number of flights that depart from the airport, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: airline_flew_most_flights
columns.description: the airline that flew the most flights to the airport, with ties broken by the ascending order of the airline name

columns.name: num_flights_landed_in_2018
columns.description: the number of flights that landed at the airport in 2018, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: highest_delay_in_minutes_due_to_security
columns.description: the highest delay in minutes due to security among flights departing from the airport

columns.name: num_cancelled_flights
columns.description: the number of cancelled flights that depart from the airport, replace NULL values with 0.
